title: Fire at riverside warehouse forces street closures
body:
A fire broke out at a riverside warehouse on Mill Lane late on Friday night, the fire service said.
Two workers were treated for smoke inhalation and taken to the county hospital as a precaution.
Residents of the nearby flats were evacuated for three hours while crews brought the fire under control.

title: Warehouse blaze: investigators look for the cause
body:
Investigators are trying to find out what started Friday's fire at the Mill Lane warehouse.
The two workers who were taken to hospital after breathing in smoke have since been released.
A separate small fire at a bakery on Station Road the same evening was put out within minutes.
